**New: [Make AI Agents](https://www.make.com/en/ai-agents) are here!** Build adaptive, intelligent automation - available now on all paid plans 🚀

# Make AI Agents: The next step in automation

Make lets you build, customize, and manage intelligent AI agents that automate your business processes, adapt in real-time, and reduce complexity like never before.

[Start using AI Agents](https://www.make.com/en/register) [Talk to sales](https://www.make.com/en/talk-to-sales)

Available on all paid plans

## Automation that adapts as fast as you do

Make AI Agents use real-time intelligence to optimize workflows and drive smarter decisions.

![Smarter automation, less maintenance](https://www.make.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2Fun655fb9wln6%2F1qEdgOHSfCmv9Sy9MbI03i%2Fb56d067a8b5de1a1382a87af357c3744%2FSmarter_automation__less_maintenance.png&w=128&q=75)

Smarter automation, less maintenance

Make AI Agents understand goals in natural language and adjust workflows dynamically instead of relying on fixed rules.

![Adaptive and scalable decision-making](https://www.make.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2Fun655fb9wln6%2FixV7VMvq3T1NMA9zAfehS%2F546e20d088d2b1446608b9a6387f117d%2FAdaptive_and_scalable_decision-making.png&w=128&q=75)

Adaptive and scalable decision-making

Combined with the power of Make apps, Make AI Agents can access the right tools, make the right decisions, and perform the right actions.

![Seamless integration across workflows](https://www.make.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2Fun655fb9wln6%2F7kaCKJgMWFJu9Di08Fzt8W%2F5aac43570b338ba1a16a52f4c11725f1%2FSeamless_integration_across_workflows.png&w=128&q=75)

Seamless integration across workflows

With 2,000+ app integrations and 30,000+ actions, Make AI Agents work with your existing systems effortlessly.

## What sets Make AI Agents apart?

![Centralised, global management](https://www.make.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2Fun655fb9wln6%2F5AmvsghY4s5IVUvxAef34P%2Ffdea2e01a3da8ae68ce346e79677b50a%2FCentralised__global_management.png&w=128&q=75)

Centralized, global management

Unlike other AI tools, Make AI Agents are reusable across multiple workflows, reducing redundancy and improving oversight.

![Customisable for any use case](https://www.make.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2Fun655fb9wln6%2F2JjetD6vS5z4KyHjIsgy8a%2Fa8650e317c42d7eff950bd219fae747e%2FCustomisable_for_any_use_case.png&w=128&q=75)

Customizable for any use case

Each agent comes with a global system prompt for consistency but allows for scenario-specific customization, ensuring flexibility without complexity.

![Real-time decision making](https://www.make.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimages.ctfassets.net%2Fun655fb9wln6%2F1iobykHYoygGCgxlL57aZ7%2F131417b4055981e82c737f45705414e3%2FReal-time_decision_making.png&w=128&q=75)

Real-time decision making

Make AI Agents allow you to choose the LLM that fits your needs, including OpenAI-compatible models. This flexibility supports real-time decision-making by adapting responses based on the selected model.

Define your AI AgentDeploy across workflowsAdapt to your environment

Create and configure AI Agents using natural language, custom prompts, and any Make scenarios as tools to access data or perform actions.
